description: Bootstrap seed only. Warehouse is details/tx/hx views over tier0 Kudu + tier1 Iceberg on RustFS. Postgres :5455 (devenv PostgreSQL 16 + AGE) is administrative — not pglite; no product/hx copies. First Signals-owned product is signals.metaflow.snapshots (immutable per-run code/data/deps on RustFS).

aspects.title: Prepared session materials
aspects.intent: Session input; immutable from the session's point of view.

aspects.title: Attachments forbidden
aspects.intent: Capability false; nonempty list is maxCount 0.

products.title: Aspect and product-spec catalog
products.agent_focus: Shapes graph: aspects are NodeShapes, not products. Quality = every product_specs.requires id exists in aspects[]. Lineage = signals-protocol pin. Delta = added/removed shapes. Nominal = A intersect P is empty.

products.title: Metaflow run snapshots
products.agent_focus: Observe data-product.tier-upkeep and confirm it is proceeding nominally (legal FSM, ADD next week, settle ≥ 4 weeks, snapshot on RustFS). Quality / lineage / delta are that observation.

products.title: Cognition outputs
products.agent_focus: Quality of extracted cognition, OL run linkage, delta vs prior curate.

products.title: Prospects corpus
products.agent_focus: Quality of retained SEC/FMP compact and summary objects on RustFS; lineage of Metaflow pathspec, code sha, and YK extract claim; delta vs prior latest_run_id; nominal walk of prospects-update (holding is not failed and not done).

products.title: Article curation chain-of-thought reasoning
products.agent_focus: Quality and depth of retained cot_reflection traces for select_article (hx.cot_reasoning on RustFS, one row per run); lineage of Metaflow pathspec, optillm technique, model, and YK extract claim; delta vs the prior run's decision; nominal walk of article-curate (reasoning that completes and lands is nominal — long generations are the product).

products.title: USD corpora
products.agent_focus: Corpus coverage, lineage of source tables, delta vs last pin.

products.title: Fine-tuned and bespoke models
products.agent_focus: Eval quality, training-run lineage, weight/adapter delta.

products.title: Classification embeddings parquet
products.agent_focus: Embedding quality, parquet schema lineage, row/column delta.

products.title: Operations Backlog (Nautilus, gaius)
products.agent_focus: The Fibonacci-hour Backlog of gaius's cadenced workflows (signals_dataproducts.nautilus_backlog / nautilus_events / nautilus_positions, project = gaius): every hourly fill is an OL run; quality = slot-0 rows filled within the horizon for every declared workflow, lineage = the instance spec_version+engine_build epoch stamped on each cell, delta = items opened/resolved since the last review, nominal = no item past its horizon_slot unsurfaced.

products.title: FMP Starter Annual warehouse
products.agent_focus: Typed FMP catalog rows on signals_dataproducts.fmp_*_tier0 (profile, filings, earnings) projected as Postgres warehouse.v_fmp_* for Metabase. Quality = flatten contracts (symbol required, market_cap DOUBLE). Lineage = FmpCall tool name + scheduled_tasks id. Delta = new as_of vs prior ts_ns. Nominal = ProjectWarehouse fields_projected > 0 on the Metabase peer (not Gaius :3100 meta.*).
